name: How long does it take to install new energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install new energy-efficient windows varies depending on the number of windows, their size, the complexity of the installation, and the condition of the existing window frames. For a typical home with 10-15 windows, the installation process usually takes 1 to 3 days. Our team works efficiently while maintaining high standards of quality and attention to detail. We provide a more precise timeline during your initial consultation after assessing your specific project requirements, ensuring minimal disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size, but typically takes 1 to 3 days for a standard home, with a precise timeline provided after consultation.
